comparison.objective: Move a tissue-roll stub to the reserve spindle, install a new primary roll, and lock the dispenser.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered bulky-part handling, simultaneous release-tab operation, spindle seating, and cover-stay release.
comparison.success_condition: Both rolls engaged on the correct hubs, cover safely closed and latched, hands clear.
comparison.reason: This tests ordered spindle loading with sprung releases and cover closure. It lacks continuous rail transfer and loss-prone circulating elements.
